items.title: File objection (Widerspruch) against refusal of exemption for boat jetty
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik.
items.computation: Letter dated 2025-09-01 (Monday); posting day assumed to be the letter date, as no other posting date is stated. Per the letter (Schleswig-Holstein administrative procedure law), the notice counts as given on the fourth day after posting: 2025-09-05 (Friday). One-month period (§ 187 (1), § 188 (2) BGB) starts the day after and ends on the day of the following month with the same number: 2025-10-05, a Sunday. Under § 193 BGB it moves to the next working day, Monday 2025-10-06, which is not a holiday in SH. The objection must reach the Kreis by then.

warnings: The posting date is not printed; the calculation assumes the letter was posted on its date, 2025-09-01. If it was posted later, the deadline moves later. To be safe, file the objection by 2025-10-06 or earlier.
